title: FEAT: Complete production workflow with branching strategy
body:
## 📋 Description

**What:** Added complete production CI/CD pipeline, branching strategy, PR merge rules, and GitHub templates.

**Why:** To establish a robust development workflow with automated testing, deployment, and code review processes.

**How:** Created 6 GitHub Actions workflows, environment configurations, branch protection rules, and PR templates following industry best practices.

## 🎯 Target Branch

- [x] `main` (production release)

## 📦 Type of Change

- [x] 🚀 Feature (new functionality)
- [x] ⚙️ CI/CD configuration

## 🔗 Related Issues

Establishes production workflow for Openclaude-App

## ✅ Checklist

### Code Quality
- [x] Code follows project standards
- [x] Self-review performed
- [x] No lint warnings

### Documentation
- [x] Documentation updated
- [x] CHANGELOG added

### Production Readiness
- [x] CI/CD pipelines configured
- [x] Environment secrets documented
- [x] Branch protection rules defined
- [x] Rollback plan documented

## 🧪 Testing Instructions

1. Verify all 6 workflow files are valid YAML
2. Check branch protection rules match documentation
3. Confirm environment configurations are correct
4. Review CODEOWNERS file for proper assignments

## 📝 Changes Summary

### CI/CD Workflows
- `ci.yml` - Lint, test, build, security scan on all PRs
- `deploy-develop.yml` - Auto debug APK on develop push
- `deploy-staging.yml` - Signed APK + release on staging push
- `deploy-production.yml` - APK + AAB to Play Store on main push
- `hotfix.yml` - Emergency signed build
- `release-drafter.yml` - Auto release notes

### Branching Strategy
- `main` → Production (Play Store)
- `staging` → Pre-production (signed APK)
- `develop` → Integration (debug build)
- `feature/*` → Development
- `hotfix/*` → Emergency

### Merge Rules
- `main`: 2 approvals, all CI pass
- `staging`: 1 approval, CI pass
- `develop`: 1 approval, CI pass

### Templates & Config
- PR template with production checklist
- CODEOWNERS for auto review assignment
- Issue templates (bug + feature)
- CHANGELOG.md
- Environment documentation

### Files Added/Modified
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
- `.github/workflows/deploy-develop.yml`
- `.github/workflows/deploy-staging.yml`
- `.github/workflows/deploy-production.yml`
- `.github/workflows/hotfix.yml`
- `.github/workflows/release-drafter.yml`
- `.github/release-drafter.yml`
- `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`
- `.github/CODEOWNERS`
- `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md`
- `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md`
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- `CHANGELOG.md`
- `docs/PRODUCTION_BRANCHING_STRATEGY.md`
- `docs/ENVIRONMENTS.md`
- `docs/BRANCH_PROTECTION_SETUP.md`
